message.reasoning_content: Describe the case. Key risk: Kahan compensation in fp32 but initial values ±2^80 dominate; 2^80+2^30 loses low bits beyond fp32 ulp; Kahan can't recover bits lost when adding values below ulp of total. Actually 2^80 ulp = 2^57, so 2^30 values are lost entirely and correction accumulates them but... correction + total: correction sum ~ (0.25–1.75 sum ~ few) can't be added to 2^80. Known catastrophic case: target exact sums are ~0 (2^80 - 2^80 cancel), but kernel returns ~7. Probe shows failure. Record description.
